race.comment: CAPTIVATE LEGEND (8) finished second over 1300m at Gold Coast two back then missed the frame last time out over 1350m at Ipswich. Has the addition of blinkers. Best form stacks up nicely and deserves another chance. WHISKEY AND WINE (7) wound up strongly only to just miss when first-up last start over 1100m at this track. Fitter for a strong return and can go one better.  LYRICAL GANGSTER (4) was well in the market on debut last time out and ran well but found one better over 1200m at Casino. Rates highly and can go on with it. PAINTED DANCER (6) turned in a moderate debut over 1210m at this track on June 13 when he was safely held in sixth, 7 lengths from the winner. Handier draw will assist. Will take a lot from that experience. Can feature in the finish. HOOKED TO CONQUER (10) is a three-year-old filly making debut by Unite And Conquer out of Gayika. Half to Group 2 winner Tarka. Nice draw and expected to run well.
